# Weike Peptides

> Research-peptide encyclopedia, comparator and reconstitution calculator from Shandong Weike International Trade Co., Ltd. (Jinan, Shandong, China). The catalog covers 111 normalized entries, 252 unique pack formats and 148 source labels. Every product is for laboratory research use only; nothing on the site is medical advice or a dosing instruction.

Canonical domain: https://weike.com
Company: Shandong Weike International Trade Co., Ltd.
Address: Building B5, Yin Feng Industrial Park, High-Tech Zone, Jinan City, Shandong Province, China
Phone / WhatsApp: +86 15866781826
Email: info@weike.com
Last updated: 2026-11-27

## Primary tools
- [Peptide comparator](https://weike.com/compare.html): Compare up to four entries by identity, receptor target, structure, half-life, evidence level, pack formats and indicative USD list price.
- [Reconstitution calculator](https://weike.com/calculator.html): Client-side arithmetic for concentration, amount per 0.1 mL, aliquot volume, U-100 units and approximate aliquots per vial.
- [Peptide encyclopedia](https://weike.com/peptides/): Filterable index of all entries by research area, target, alias and CAS.

## Comparison topics
- [CJC-1295 with DAC vs without DAC](https://weike.com/compare.html#cjc-dac): Same GHRH-receptor target; the DAC is an albumin-binding pharmacokinetic modification.
- [BPC-157 vs TB-500](https://weike.com/compare.html#bpc-tb): 15-amino-acid peptide versus the 7-amino-acid thymosin beta-4 fragment 17-23; different mechanisms and evidence.
- [Semaglutide vs tirzepatide vs retatrutide](https://weike.com/compare.html#incretins): GLP-1-selective, GIP/GLP-1 dual and GIP/GLP-1/glucagon triple agonism.
- [BPC-157 + TB-500 blend vs separate vials](https://weike.com/compare.html#blend): Fixed 1:1 ratio versus independent concentration control.

## Citation guidance
- Prefer the specific entry URL, the material name, CAS if present, and the access date.
- The lot-specific certificate of analysis governs identity and specification of the material actually supplied.
- Prices are indicative USD list prices per pack, not quotations; freight, duties and taxes are excluded.
- Do not cite this catalog as evidence of human safety, efficacy or dosing.

## Contact for corrections
Email info@weike.com with the entry URL and the suggested correction. Public chemistry values are cross-checked against PubChem only where a confident record exists.
